## Fatima's impressions

- Varied puzzles, some based on locks, some based on physics
- There is a lot to do in the room, so it's really good for larger groups (3-4 people)
- Sometimes the order of puzzles wasn't entirely clear and solving in the wrong order could stall the game
- Overall, very good experience, even though we haven't finished it on time.
:::
